znr.text: Zareth San returns to Sea Gate, apologizes to Akiri for leaving, and is forgiven and welcomed home as the two climb the Umara River Gorge looking for a fallen hedron.

When Akiri reveals a secret Skyclave expedition to Murasa and insists on fixing Zendikar, Zareth promises to be there, and he later tells Kesenya he fears what the Lithoform Core will do and plans to steal it.
On the Magosi Steps a giant serpent, Verazol, devours the caravan, and Zareth first runs and then dives off the switchback, and Akiri catches him with her line, saving them both.

In the Murasa Skyclave, Nahiri takes the Core as the chamber begins to collapse, and when a lava elemental attacks and Akiri shields Zareth, he is killed by the Core's blast, and Akiri grieves the person she loved.
